name: XWiki
description: Enterprise wiki platform with structured data, applications, and extensible page templates.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DB_USER: xwiki
      DB_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      DB_DATABASE: xwiki
      DB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/usr/local/xwiki
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: xwiki
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: xwiki
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
